//: Manifest V3 variant. See README.md -> 'Manifest V3'. Swap this over manifest.json to use it.
//host_permissions: In Firefox MV3 host permissions are NOT granted at install time. The extension cannot read image bytes until the user grants access (about:addons -> this add-on -> Permissions -> 'Access your data for all websites'), or you accept it per-site via the toolbar. That friction is why MV2 is the default here.
name: Save WebP as JPG / PNG
description: Right-click a WebP image and save it as JPG or PNG. Conversion happens locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
